title: Lizard Defender
description: Defend your home from pesky insects by controlling your lizard! Click or move quickly to stop bugs from invading.
how_to_play:
1. Press Play to start the game.
2. Control the lizard using arrow keys or mouse.
3. Catch the insects before they reach your house.
4. Each insect gives points.
5. Survive as long as possible to get a high score.

Tips:
- Keep moving to catch insects efficiently.
- Focus on clusters of insects.
- Don’t get overwhelmed by multiple insects at once.
